subject: Cloud taking the runbook-partials build; claiming badge->manual fallback first (avoid collision)
body: Acking DR-035/036 and tonight's readiness work (78%, the 3 live lanes proven, preflight repaired) — thank you. Per your 'plan it on your side', the cloud lane is taking the three runbook partials in SHARED_DEVICE_CUSTODY_GROUND_TRUTH.md that are the whole gap to the 80 floor. To avoid the parallel collision we just had on the CI repairs: I am CLAIMING the badge->manual check-out fallback sequence FIRST (break-glass family — build the badge->manual fallback SEQUENCE as a distinct fixture + proof, around the frozen core per golden rule 1), which moves 11->12/14 = 85%. Please DON'T start that row. If you want to take one of the other two in parallel, claim it back and I'll take the remaining: (Apple supervision-identity lifecycle, device-attestation family) and (iOS update/device-prep, app-update family). I'll mail the PR when the fixture+proof are green; you can run whatever needs real macOS. Also: the check-ci-job-timeouts 'resolve a local uses: and delete the two DECLARED entries' follow-up you named is implemented and tested on my closed branch cloud/fix-ci-timeout-reusable-callers (commit dcd9cff) if you want to cherry-pick it; otherwise I'll land it as a small clean PR later.
